words.hint: Sounds cold if used to someone you know; say their name + さん instead.
あの (that over there) + 人 (person).

Country + 人: 日本人 Japanese, アメリカ人 American.
先 (ahead) + 生 (born): someone born before you.
学 (study) + 生 (life).
会社 (company) + 員 (member).
Used with a company name: IMCの社員.
銀行 (bank) + 員 (member).
大 (big) + 学 (study).
Not びよういん (beauty salon): keep びょう short.
Polite form: おいくつ.
From 初め (first time): said only at a first meeting.

words.word: よろしくお願いします
words.kana: よろしくおねがいします
words.hint: Said after introducing yourself.

sentences.sentence: わたし{}マイク・ミラーです。
sentences.translation: I am Mike Miller.
sentences.explanation: は marks the topic; as a particle it is read “wa”.

sentences.sentence: サントスさんは学生{}。
sentences.translation: Mr Santos is not a student.
sentences.explanation: じゃありません is the polite “is not”.

sentences.sentence: ミラーさんはアメリカ人です{}。
sentences.translation: Is Mr Miller American?
sentences.explanation: か at the end turns a sentence into a question.

sentences.sentence: グプタさん{}会社員です。
sentences.translation: Mr Gupta is also a company employee.
sentences.explanation: も (“also”) replaces は when the same applies again.

sentences.sentence: ミラーさんはＩＭＣ{}社員です。
sentences.translation: Mr Miller is an employee of IMC.
sentences.explanation: N₁ の N₂: the N₂ that belongs to N₁.

words.hint: こ = near me, そ = near you, あ = over there, ど = which.
この needs a noun after it; これ stands alone.
A tree (木) with a line at its root: the origin, a book.
新 (new) + 聞 (hear): new things heard.
From English "note".
The kanji looks like an open umbrella.
The kanji is a cart seen from above: body and two axles.
なん before です; なに before を and most other words.
Literally "it differs".

sentences.sentence: {}は辞書です。
sentences.translation: This is a dictionary.
sentences.explanation: これ stands alone as “this (thing)”; この needs a noun after it.

sentences.sentence: {}本はわたしのです。
sentences.translation: This book is mine.
sentences.explanation: この comes before a noun: この本 “this book”.

sentences.sentence: それはボールペンです{}、シャープペンシルですか。
sentences.translation: Is that a ballpoint pen or a mechanical pencil?
sentences.explanation: 〜か、〜か asks which of two.

sentences.sentence: この傘はだれ{}ですか。
sentences.translation: Whose umbrella is this?
sentences.explanation: だれの “whose”: の can stand for the thing owned.

sentences.sentence: これは本ですか。…いいえ、{}。
sentences.translation: Is this a book? …No, it isn’t.
sentences.explanation: 違います “that’s wrong / it isn’t” answers a yes/no question with no.

words.hint: Polite ここ; also "this person" in introductions.
教 (teach) + 室 (room).
食 (eat) + 堂 (hall).
会議 (meeting) + 室 (room).
From 受け付ける, to accept (visitors).
Literally "hand-washing place".
Also read いえ. The kanji: a pig (豕) under a roof (宀).
売り (selling) + 場 (place).
地 (ground) + 下 (below).
3階 is さんがい, not さんかい.
Japanese counts in 万: 10,000 is 一万, 100,000 is 十万.

sentences.sentence: トイレは{}ですか。
sentences.translation: Where is the toilet?
sentences.explanation: どこ asks “where”.

sentences.sentence: {}は食堂です。
sentences.translation: This place is the cafeteria.
sentences.explanation: ここ is “here / this place”; これ is “this thing”.

sentences.sentence: これはどこ{}車ですか。
sentences.translation: Where is this car made?
sentences.explanation: Country の product: where something comes from.

sentences.sentence: 会社は{}ですか。
sentences.translation: Which company do you work for? (polite)
sentences.explanation: どちら is the polite どこ.

words.hint: 人 (person) + 動 (move): a person in motion.
A person (亻) leaning on a tree (木).
4時 is よじ, 7時 is しちじ, 9時 is くじ.
ふん or ぷん: 1分 いっぷん, 5分 ごふん, 10分 じゅっぷん.
午 (noon) + 前 (before).
午 (noon) + 後 (after).
毎 (every) + 朝 (morning); same with 毎日, 毎晩.
銀 (silver) + 行 (go): where money goes.
図書 (books) + 館 (building).
Moon day; 火 fire Tue, 水 water Wed, 木 wood Thu, 金 gold Fri, 土 earth Sat, 日 sun Sun.

sentences.sentence: 毎朝６時{}起きます。
sentences.translation: I get up at six every morning.
sentences.explanation: に marks a clock time.

sentences.sentence: ９時{}５時まで働きます。
sentences.translation: I work from nine to five.
sentences.explanation: から “from”, まで “until”.

sentences.sentence: きのうは勉強し{}。
sentences.translation: I didn’t study yesterday.
sentences.explanation: 〜ませんでした is the polite past negative.

sentences.sentence: 銀行の休みは土曜日{}日曜日です。
sentences.translation: The bank is closed on Saturdays and Sundays.
sentences.explanation: と joins nouns: “A and B”.

words.hint: Only for going back to where you belong (home, your country).
Has 馬 (horse): once a post-horse station.
飛 (fly) + 行 (go) + 機 (machine).
電 (electric) + 車 (vehicle).
地下 (underground) + 鉄 (iron).
自 (self) + 転 (turn) + 車: a vehicle you turn yourself.
No で: 歩いて行きます.
先 last, 今 this, 来 next: 先週, 今週, 来週.
去 (gone) + 年 (year).
誕生 (birth) + 日 (day).

sentences.sentence: 来月、日本{}行きます。
sentences.translation: I’m going to Japan next month.
sentences.explanation: へ (read “e”) marks where you go. に works too.

sentences.sentence: 日曜日はどこへ{}行きません。
sentences.translation: I don’t go anywhere on Sundays.
sentences.explanation: Question word + も + negative: “not anywhere / nothing / nobody”.

sentences.sentence: 電車{}会社へ行きます。
sentences.translation: I go to work by train.
sentences.explanation: で marks the means of transport.

sentences.sentence: 家族{}日本へ来ました。
sentences.translation: I came to Japan with my family.
sentences.explanation: Person と: “together with”.

sentences.sentence: {}日本へ来ましたか。
sentences.translation: When did you come to Japan?
sentences.explanation: いつ asks “when” and needs no particle.

words.hint: Also for taking medicine: 薬を飲みます.
The kanji: an eye (目) on legs.
An ear (耳) at the gate (門).
Takes に: 友達に会います.
朝ごはん, 昼ごはん, 晩ごはん: breakfast, lunch, dinner.
From Portuguese "pão".
The kanji: head, body with scales, and a tail (灬).
牛 (cow) + 乳 (milk).
写 (copy) + 真 (truth): a true copy.
々 repeats the kanji before it: 時々 = 時時.

sentences.sentence: ジュース{}飲みます。
sentences.translation: I drink juice.
sentences.explanation: を (read “o”) marks the object of the verb.

sentences.sentence: 駅{}新聞を買います。
sentences.translation: I buy a newspaper at the station.
sentences.explanation: Place で verb: where the action happens.

sentences.sentence: いっしょに京都へ行き{}。
sentences.translation: Won’t you go to Kyoto with me?
sentences.explanation: 〜ませんか politely invites.

sentences.sentence: ええ、行き{}。
sentences.translation: Yes, let’s go.
sentences.explanation: 〜ましょう “let’s”.

sentences.sentence: 日曜日、{}をしますか。
sentences.translation: What do you do on Sundays?
sentences.explanation: Before を, “what” is なに (なん comes before d-, t-, n- sounds).

words.hint: Giving away from you (or your side).
The giver takes に or から.
Lend = かします; borrow = かります. Easy to mix up: か"し" goes out.
The kanji: wings (羽) over white (白): a chick practising to fly.
Same sound as 橋 (bridge); context tells them apart.
Short for パーソナル・コンピューター.
艹 (grass) + 化 (change): a plant that changes into bloom.
金 alone is gold or metal.
Someone else’s father: お父さん.
Someone else’s mother: お母さん.
まだです answers "Have you … yet?" with no.

sentences.sentence: はし{}ごはんを食べます。
sentences.translation: I eat with chopsticks.
sentences.explanation: で marks the tool or means.

sentences.sentence: 「Thank you」は日本語{}何ですか。
sentences.translation: What is “Thank you” in Japanese?
sentences.explanation: Language で: “in (a language)”.

sentences.sentence: わたしは木村さんに花を{}。
sentences.translation: I gave Ms Kimura flowers.
sentences.explanation: あげます: the giver is the subject, the receiver takes に.

sentences.sentence: わたしは父{}ネクタイをもらいました。
sentences.translation: I received a tie from my father.
sentences.explanation: With もらいます, the giver takes に (or から).

sentences.sentence: もう昼ごはんを食べましたか。…いいえ、{}です。
sentences.translation: Have you had lunch yet? …No, not yet.
sentences.explanation: まだです “not yet”.

words.hint: A な-adjective even though it ends in い.
有 (have) + 名 (name).
For people use 年を取った.
Past and negative come from よい: よかった, よくない.
Hot to the touch is 熱い; same sound.
Cold to the touch is 冷たい.
やさしい also means kind (優しい).
Opposites: 安い (cheap), 低い (low).
Usually written in kana.
忄 (heart) + 亡 (lost): so busy you lose your heart.
Always followed by a negative.

sentences.sentence: ここは静か{}町です。
sentences.translation: This is a quiet town.
sentences.explanation: A な-adjective takes な before a noun.

sentences.sentence: この本はあまりおもしろく{}。
sentences.translation: This book isn’t very interesting.
sentences.explanation: い-adjective negative: drop い, add くないです.

sentences.sentence: 日本の食べ物はおいしいです{}、高いです。
sentences.translation: Japanese food is tasty, but expensive.
sentences.explanation: Sentence が sentence: “…, but …”.

sentences.sentence: 奈良は{}町ですか。
sentences.translation: What kind of town is Nara?
sentences.explanation: どんな + noun asks “what kind of”.

sentences.sentence: この料理は{}おいしいです。
sentences.translation: This dish is very tasty.
sentences.explanation: とても “very” goes with positives; あまり needs a negative.

words.hint: Takes が: 日本語が分かります.
女 (woman) + 子 (child): what you love.
Don’t say it about yourself; say 得意 instead.
飲み (drink) + 物 (thing); 食べ物 is food.
野 (field) + 球 (ball).
音 (sound) + 楽 (enjoy).
漢 (Han China) + 字 (character).
Usually written in kana.
Formal: なぜ; casual: なんで.

sentences.sentence: わたしはイタリア料理{}好きです。
sentences.translation: I like Italian food.
sentences.explanation: 好き takes が for what you like.

sentences.sentence: 日本語{}少しわかります。
sentences.translation: I understand a little Japanese.
sentences.explanation: わかります takes が for what you understand.

sentences.sentence: 時間がありません{}、新聞を読みません。
sentences.translation: I don’t read the paper because I have no time.
sentences.explanation: Reason から, result: “because …, …”.

sentences.sentence: {}早く帰りますか。
sentences.translation: Why are you going home early?
sentences.explanation: どうして asks “why”.

words.hint: Living, moving things います; objects あります.
男: a field (田) + strength (力): the one working the field.
大 with a dot: a big dog’s ear.
Looks like a tree: trunk, branches, roots.
冷 (cold) + 蔵 (store) + 庫 (warehouse).
From "building", not "bill".
Thing + 屋 = a shop selling it: パン屋, 花屋.
The line sits above the base.
右 has a mouth (口): the hand you eat with. 左 has 工 (work).
A line through the middle of a box.
Sun (日) seen between the gate doors (門).

sentences.sentence: あそこに男の人が{}。
sentences.translation: There is a man over there.
sentences.explanation: います for people and animals; あります for things.

sentences.sentence: 机の上に本が{}。
sentences.translation: There is a book on the desk.
sentences.explanation: あります for things that don’t move by themselves.

sentences.sentence: 郵便局は銀行の{}にあります。
sentences.translation: The post office is next to the bank.
sentences.explanation: N の となり “next to N”.

sentences.sentence: 箱の中に手紙{}写真があります。
sentences.translation: In the box there are letters, photos and so on.
sentences.explanation: や lists a few examples (“A, B and so on”).

sentences.sentence: ミラーさんは会議室{}います。
sentences.translation: Mr Miller is in the meeting room.
sentences.explanation: Place に います/あります: where someone or something is.

words.hint: ひとつ, ふたつ, みっつ, よっつ, いつつ, むっつ, ななつ, やっつ, ここのつ, とお.
The only one with no つ.
ひとり, ふたり, then さんにん, よにん…
Paper, shirts, stamps, tickets.
Usually written in kana.
切 (cut) + 手: a small cut-out piece.
両 (both) + 親 (parent).
Someone else’s: お兄さん.
Someone else’s: お姉さん.
外 (outside) + 国 (country).
Without か: 2月 is February, 2か月 is two months.

sentences.sentence: りんごを{}買いました。
sentences.translation: I bought four apples.
sentences.explanation: 〜つ counts general things; 人 people, 枚 flat things, 台 machines.

sentences.sentence: この会社に外国人が{}います。
sentences.translation: There are three foreigners at this company.
sentences.explanation: 〜人 counts people.

sentences.sentence: 国で２か月{}日本語を勉強しました。
sentences.translation: I studied Japanese for about two months in my country.
sentences.explanation: Amount + ぐらい “about”.

sentences.sentence: 休みは日曜日{}です。
sentences.translation: My only day off is Sunday.
sentences.explanation: だけ “only” works with a positive; しか needs a negative verb.

sentences.sentence: １時間{}寝ませんでした。
sentences.translation: I only slept for an hour.
sentences.explanation: しか + negative: “nothing but”.

words.hint: Early is 早い; same sound.
Used as a predicate: 人が多いです (not 多い人).
禾 (grain) + 火 (fire): burning the harvest stubble.
天 (sky) + 気 (spirit, air).
The kanji: drops falling from a cloud.

sentences.sentence: きのうは雨{}。
sentences.translation: It was rainy yesterday.
sentences.explanation: Noun + でした is the polite past.

sentences.sentence: 旅行は楽し{}。
sentences.translation: The trip was fun.
sentences.explanation: い-adjective past: drop い, add かったです (never いでした).

sentences.sentence: 中国は日本{}大きいです。
sentences.translation: China is bigger than Japan.
sentences.explanation: A は B より …: “A is more … than B”.

sentences.sentence: スポーツの中で何が{}好きですか。
sentences.translation: Which sport do you like the most?
sentences.explanation: いちばん “the most”.

sentences.sentence: きのうは寒く{}。
sentences.translation: It wasn’t cold yesterday.
sentences.explanation: い-adjective past negative: 〜くなかったです.

words.hint: Not for sports or instruments (those use します / 弾きます).
Say 疲れました: "I’m tired".
Takes を for where: 公園を散歩します.
Literally "big change".
Takes が: 車が欲しいです.
Three lines of flowing water.
Long スキー (ski) vs short すき (like).
週 (week) + 末 (end).
For times: 3時ごろ. For amounts use ぐらい.
Literally "throat gets dry".
Literally "stomach gets empty".

sentences.sentence: わたしは新しい車{}ほしいです。
sentences.translation: I want a new car.
sentences.explanation: ほしい takes が for the thing wanted.

sentences.sentence: 沖縄へ行き{}です。
sentences.translation: I want to go to Okinawa.
sentences.explanation: Verb stem + たいです “want to do”.

sentences.sentence: デパートへ靴を買い{}行きます。
sentences.translation: I’m going to the department store to buy shoes.
sentences.explanation: Verb stem に 行きます: go in order to do.

sentences.sentence: のどがかわきましたから、{}飲みたいです。
sentences.translation: I’m thirsty, so I want to drink something.
sentences.explanation: 何か “something”; 何も + negative is “nothing”.

words.hint: Gate (門) with hands pulling the bar: open.
Te-form: 待って. ちょっと待ってください.
An ear (耳) and a hand (又): soldiers took ears as trophies.
From 手 (hand): to lend a hand.
From 見 (see): make someone see.
The kanji: a person standing on the ground.
Takes に: 部屋に入ります.
Takes を: 部屋を出ます.
住 (live) + 所 (place).
Verb stem + 方 = how to: 書き方, 使い方.

sentences.sentence: ちょっと待っ{}ください。
sentences.translation: Please wait a moment.
sentences.explanation: 待ちます → 待って: て-form + ください.

sentences.sentence: この漢字の読み方を教え{}。
sentences.translation: Please tell me how to read this kanji.
sentences.explanation: て-form + ください: a polite request.

sentences.sentence: ミラーさんは今、電話をかけ{}。
sentences.translation: Mr Miller is making a phone call now.
sentences.explanation: て-form + います: an action in progress.

sentences.sentence: 暑いですね。窓を開け{}。
sentences.translation: It’s hot, isn’t it? Shall I open the window?
sentences.explanation: 〜ましょうか offers help: “shall I …?”.

sentences.sentence: 「飲みます」のて形は「{}」です。
sentences.translation: The te-form of nomimasu is nonde.
sentences.explanation: Group 1 verbs in み・び・に → んで.

words.hint: Same sound as 起きます (get up).
Know = 知っています; don’t know = 知りません.
Live in = 住んでいます, with に.
歯 (tooth) + 医者 (doctor).
独 (alone) + 身 (body).
Asking to take one: 写真を撮ってもいいですか.
Smoke one: たばこを吸います.
A state, so ています.
思い (thought) + 出します (take out).

sentences.sentence: 写真を撮っ{}いいですか。
sentences.translation: May I take a photo?
sentences.explanation: 〜てもいいですか asks permission.

sentences.sentence: ここでたばこを吸っ{}いけません。
sentences.translation: You must not smoke here.
sentences.explanation: 〜てはいけません: “must not”.

sentences.sentence: わたしは大阪に住ん{}。
sentences.translation: I live in Osaka.
sentences.explanation: 住みます → 住んで; 〜ています for a lasting state.

sentences.sentence: わたしは結婚し{}。
sentences.translation: I am married.
sentences.explanation: 結婚しています: the state that results from marrying.

words.hint: 亡 (lost) over 心 (heart): lost from the mind.
心 (heart) + 配 (distribute).
残 (remain) + 業 (work).

words.meaning: to go on a business trip

words.hint: 禁 (forbid) + 煙 (smoke).
艹 (plants) + 楽 (comfort): healing herbs.
Take a bath: お風呂に入ります.
上 (over) + 着 (wear).
まで = until (keeps going); までに = by (done before).

sentences.sentence: 「行きます」のない形は「{}」です。
sentences.translation: The nai-form of ikimasu is ikanai.
sentences.explanation: Group 1: change the い-sound before ます to あ, add ない.

sentences.sentence: ここに車を止め{}ください。
sentences.translation: Please don’t park your car here.
sentences.explanation: ない-form + で ください: “please don’t”.

sentences.sentence: 薬を飲ま{}なりません。
sentences.translation: I have to take medicine.
sentences.explanation: 〜なければなりません: “must”.

sentences.sentence: あしたは来{}いいです。
sentences.translation: You don’t have to come tomorrow.
sentences.explanation: 〜なくてもいいです: “don’t have to”.

sentences.sentence: 荷物はここ{}置かないでください。
sentences.translation: Please don’t put your luggage here.
sentences.explanation: Place に 置きます: where something is put.

words.hint: Has 弓 (bow): plucking a string.
予 (in advance) + 約 (promise).
現 (present) + 金 (money).
日 (day) + 記 (record).
動 (move) + 物 (thing).
The kanji: mane, legs (灬) and tail.
With a negative: なかなか覚えられません.
Usually written in kana.
本当ですか: Really?
Dictionary form + 前に: 寝る前に.

sentences.sentence: わたしはピアノを弾く{}ができます。
sentences.translation: I can play the piano.
sentences.explanation: Dictionary form + ことができます: “can do”.

sentences.sentence: わたしの趣味は写真を撮る{}です。
sentences.translation: My hobby is taking photos.
sentences.explanation: Dictionary form + こと makes an action a noun.

sentences.sentence: 寝る{}、歯をみがきます。
sentences.translation: I brush my teeth before I go to bed.
sentences.explanation: Dictionary form + まえに: “before doing”.

sentences.sentence: 「書きます」の辞書形は「{}」です。
sentences.translation: The dictionary form of kakimasu is kaku.
sentences.explanation: Group 1: change the い-sound before ます to う.

sentences.sentence: 食事の{}、手を洗います。
sentences.translation: I wash my hands before meals.
sentences.explanation: Noun の まえに: “before (a meal, a meeting…)”.

words.hint: Takes に: 山に登ります.
Has 氵 (water): boats moored for the night.
い-adj → く: 寒くなります. な-adj / noun → に: 元気になります.
調子がいい / 悪い: feeling well / unwell.
一度も + negative: never once.
Three peaks.
さん here is 山 (mountain), not Mr.
Said when asked how you are.

sentences.sentence: わたしは北海道へ行った{}があります。
sentences.translation: I have been to Hokkaido.
sentences.explanation: た-form + ことがあります: “have done (before)”.

sentences.sentence: 日曜日はテニスをし{}、映画を見たりします。
sentences.translation: On Sundays I do things like play tennis and watch films.
sentences.explanation: 〜たり、〜たりします lists some of the things you do.

sentences.sentence: だんだん寒{}なりました。
sentences.translation: It has gradually got colder.
sentences.explanation: い-adjective: drop い, add くなります (“become”).

sentences.sentence: 元気{}なりました。
sentences.translation: I got well again.
sentences.explanation: な-adjective or noun + になります.

sentences.sentence: 「飲みます」のた形は「{}」です。
sentences.translation: The ta-form of nomimasu is nonda.
sentences.explanation: The た-form follows the て-form: 飲んで → 飲んだ.

words.hint: Plain form + と思います.
Spelled いいます; said ゆいます in casual speech.
Takes が: ビザが要ります.
From 足 (foot, also "add").
Losing an item is なくします.
Falling tone: no. Rising うん: yes.
言 (say) + 葉 (leaf): leaves of speech.
着 (wear) + 物 (thing).
Pairs with と思います / でしょう.

sentences.sentence: あしたは雨が降る{}思います。
sentences.translation: I think it will rain tomorrow.
sentences.explanation: Plain form + と思います: “I think …”.

sentences.sentence: 「行きます」の普通形は「{}」です。
sentences.translation: The plain form of ikimasu is iku.
sentences.explanation: The plain present is the dictionary form.

sentences.sentence: ミラーさんは来週東京へ行く{}言いました。
sentences.translation: Mr Miller said he will go to Tokyo next week.
sentences.explanation: Plain form + と言いました reports what someone said.

sentences.sentence: 日本は物価が高い{}思います。
sentences.translation: I think prices in Japan are high.
sentences.explanation: An い-adjective is already plain: 高い + と思います.

words.hint: Above the waist 着ます, below はきます, hats かぶります.
たち makes a plural for people.
目 (eye) + 鏡 (mirror, lens).
和 (Japan) + 室 (room).

words.word: お目出度うございます
words.kana: おめでとうございます
words.hint: Usually written in kana.

sentences.sentence: めがねをかけている{}はミラーさんです。
sentences.translation: The person wearing glasses is Mr Miller.
sentences.explanation: A plain-form clause comes straight before the noun it describes.

sentences.sentence: これはわたし{}作ったケーキです。
sentences.translation: This is a cake I made.
sentences.explanation: Inside a noun-describing clause, the subject takes が (or の), not は.

sentences.sentence: ミラーさんが住んでいる{}はどこですか。
sentences.translation: Where is the house Mr Miller lives in?
sentences.explanation: The clause 住んでいる describes うち.

sentences.sentence: わたしは朝ごはんを食べる{}がありません。
sentences.translation: I have no time to eat breakfast.
sentences.explanation: Dictionary form + 時間: “time to do”.

words.hint: Push is 押します.
Takes に: ドアに触ります.
止 (stop) over 少: little steps.
Takes を: 道を渡ります.
気を付けて: Take care.
交差 (crossing) + 点 (point).
木 (wood) on the left: wooden bridges.
駐車 (parking) + 場 (place).
As とき in sentences: 暇なとき.
二つ目の角: the second corner.

sentences.sentence: 図書館で本を借りる{}、カードが要ります。
sentences.translation: When you borrow books at the library, you need a card.
sentences.explanation: 〜とき: “when …”.

sentences.sentence: このボタンを押す{}、お釣りが出ます。
sentences.translation: If you press this button, your change comes out.
sentences.explanation: Dictionary form + と: a result that always follows.

sentences.sentence: 道{}渡って、右へ曲がってください。
sentences.translation: Cross the road and turn right, please.
sentences.explanation: を marks the place you move through or across.

sentences.sentence: 暇な{}、何をしますか。
sentences.translation: What do you do when you’re free?
sentences.explanation: な-adjective + な + とき.

words.hint: Takes に: 駅に着きます.
留 (stay) + 学 (study).
頑張って: Good luck!
A special reading: no kanji reads い or なか here.
Pairs with たら: もし雨が降ったら.
With ても: いくら考えても… however much I think.
もの is a physical thing; こと an idea or event.

words.meaning: thank you for all your help
words.hint: Said when leaving a job, a home stay or a class.

sentences.sentence: 雨が降っ{}、行きません。
sentences.translation: If it rains, I won’t go.
sentences.explanation: た-form + ら: “if / when …”.

sentences.sentence: 雨が降っ{}、行きます。
sentences.translation: Even if it rains, I’ll go.
sentences.explanation: て-form + も: “even if …”.

sentences.sentence: どうし{}いいですか。
sentences.translation: What should I do?
sentences.explanation: Question word + 〜たらいいですか asks for advice.

sentences.sentence: パーティーに学生が２００人{}来ました。
sentences.translation: As many as 200 students came to the party.
sentences.explanation: Amount + も: “as many as”.

sentences.sentence: お金が５００円{}ありません。
sentences.translation: I only have 500 yen.
sentences.explanation: Amount + しか + negative: “only”.

words.hint: Toward you or your side; あげます goes away from you.
Also "to send"; with a person it means see them off.
Long い: おじいさん. Short おじさん is uncle.
Long あ: おばあさん. Short おばさん is aunt.

sentences.sentence: 佐藤さんがわたしにチョコレートを{}。
sentences.translation: Ms Sato gave me chocolate.
sentences.explanation: くれます: someone gives to me (or my side).

sentences.sentence: わたしは木村さんに本を貸して{}。
sentences.translation: I lent Ms Kimura a book (as a favour).
sentences.explanation: て-form + あげます: I do something for someone.

sentences.sentence: わたしは母に料理を教えて{}。
sentences.translation: My mother taught me how to cook.
sentences.explanation: て-form + もらいます: I receive a favour from someone (に).

sentences.sentence: {}がその時計をくれましたか。
sentences.translation: Who gave you that watch?
sentences.explanation: だれが asks who did it.

words.hint: Something comes into view; 見られます is "able to see" by choice.
Same sound as 買います (buy); 飼 has 食 (feed).
Often with てしまいました: なくしてしまいました.
The kanji: head, eye, body and tail feathers.
花 (flower) + 火 (fire): fire flowers.
自動 (automatic) + 販売 (sales) + 機 (machine).
Usually written in kana.

sentences.sentence: わたしは日本語{}話せます。
sentences.translation: I can speak Japanese.
sentences.explanation: A potential verb usually takes が for its object.

sentences.sentence: 「泳ぎます」の可能形は「{}」です。
sentences.translation: The potential form of oyogimasu is oyogemasu.
sentences.explanation: Group 1: change the い-sound before ます to え.

sentences.sentence: 部屋の窓から海が{}。
sentences.translation: You can see the sea from my room’s window.
sentences.explanation: 見えます: something is visible (no effort).

sentences.sentence: 宿題を忘れて{}。
sentences.translation: I (regrettably) forgot my homework.
sentences.explanation: て-form + しまいました: done completely, often with regret.

sentences.sentence: ひらがな{}書けません。
sentences.translation: I can only write hiragana.
sentences.explanation: しか + negative potential: “can only”.

words.hint: 間 (gap) + 合 (fit): the gap fits.
Opposite of 捨てます (throw away).
気分が悪い: feel unwell.
財 (wealth) + 布 (cloth).
Usually written in kana.
Question word + でも = any: どこでも anywhere, だれでも anyone.
こんな / そんな / あんな follow こ・そ・あ.
Cold water is 水; hot water has its own word.
た-form + 後で: 食べた後で.

sentences.sentence: 頭が痛い{}、早く帰ります。
sentences.translation: I have a headache, so I’ll go home early.
sentences.explanation: 〜ので gives a reason, a little softer than から.

sentences.sentence: これは「すし」{}食べ物です。
sentences.translation: This is a food called sushi.
sentences.explanation: N₁ という N₂: “an N₂ called N₁”.

sentences.sentence: ごはんを食べた{}、歯をみがきます。
sentences.translation: I brush my teeth after eating.
sentences.explanation: た-form + あとで: “after doing”.

sentences.sentence: どこで切符を買っ{}いいですか。
sentences.translation: Where should I buy the ticket?
sentences.explanation: Question word + 〜たらいいですか asks what to do.
